Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Card text of The Embrace:
Put this card in play; it becomes a 1 capacity vampire. This vampire is not
considered unique, must hunt the turn, and is the same clan as the acting
vampire.

Since "Caitiff" is not a clan, what happens if, say, Dan Murdock plays The
Embrace?
Is it a Caitiff?
Or is it a non-Caitiff clanless vampire?
Or is the card an illegal play because there is no "clan" to inherit?
